name: Aceptex
source:
Aceptex can only be seen and heard by the protagonist. She is a haughty and beautiful girl who strives to be an adult and acts like a woman with weak instincts. Since Shinfu is the first man to recognize her, she often expresses her desire to rely on him in a strong tone. She is more knowledgeable than him in many ways.

[From [url=https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/character.php?character=10746]ErogameScape[/url].]
